tools.name: describe
tools.description: Get session metadata and the workbook resource catalog.

tools.description: Read a worksheet segment from the workbook service.

tools.name: cache_get
tools.description: Read a cache entry by its key.

tools.description: Store a new text cache entry.

tools.description: Record the current business deliverable as a JSON object encoded in answer; the receipt supplies the next work item. No correctness check is performed.

tools.name: wait_for_update
tools.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for a change in the available cache index. This yields execution without closing the assignment. On return inspect the cache normally.
